does_not_cover: None of L01's descriptive core appears: no location, spread, histograms, or sampling-context material.
Title implies a paradox resolution but the counting solution is asserted early and the rest is formula advocacy, not new evidence.
notes: Dense but well-paced; concrete-population counting throughout. Teaches knowledge-sad-l04-conditional and knowledge-sad-l04-bayes (Bayes factor, odds-form Bayes) at length — reassignment signal, kept out of teaches. Prior-as-prevalence substitution is flagged in-video.

segments.topic: Paradox setup: accurate test yet positive result means 1 in 11
Sensitivity, specificity, and the doctors who answered 9 in 10
Reframing: tests update prior chances, not final answers
Bayes factor as sensitivity over false-positive rate, rule of thumb
Odds form: posterior odds equal prior odds times the factor
Worked variants: other priors, sharper tests, negative results
Standard Bayes formula contrasted with the odds framing

suggested_locator: 00:00-02:09 for the counting paradox; 11:01-13:07 for the odds-form derivation

teaches.why: Shows base-rate neglect by counting true vs false positives in populations.
Computes sensitivity, specificity, false rates, and predictive value on one table.
